scope: startup locator and bounded content repair only; independent from later blind business trial

criteria.title: Authorization and preservation
criteria.rule: Only marker-scoped AGENTS/onboarding/startup changes; app, original employees, old case and method including proposals unchanged. No event/network/config/Git write or ownership expansion.

criteria.title: Local method discovery
criteria.rule: Normal documented invocation finds exactly the explicitly authorized local repository without --method-root hint. Locator is metadata only; absent/malformed/wrong locator fails closed with no filesystem search or fallback network.

criteria.title: Method identity
criteria.rule: Continue fixed origin a848db9 HEAD, exact ten-file tree, regular Git blob and worktree byte equality. Wrong origin/revision, dirty body, missing/extra tracked file, permission denial and symlink/ancestor substitution cannot produce readable fixed-method PASS.

criteria.title: Bounded full content
criteria.rule: Provide manifest and individually requestable bounded page for every selected input. Split by character/UTF8 bytes rather than line count; a single giant line must cross pages without omission or duplication. Entire serialized page remains under documented safe maximum.

criteria.title: Coverage and binding
criteria.rule: Each page stably identifies source/version/full-source hash, page index/count, byte/character range and page hash. Reassembling all pages exactly matches original bytes, including UTF8, CRLF, no terminal newline and long single lines. Manifest-only/hash-only is not fulltext delivery.

criteria.title: Drift and invalid page
criteria.rule: Out-of-range/invalid selection or changed content/version between manifest and page must be explicit; no stale page silently substitutes. Wrong source, traversal, absolute path and unsafe locator are rejected.

criteria.title: Compatibility
criteria.rule: Preserve explicit --method-root and --include-content behavior and prior supported role/evidence semantics. Metadata-only default stays body-free; ownership unknown, understanding unverified, no automatic adoption or connection claim; exit0 only mechanical.

criteria.title: Current project history
criteria.rule: At least prior validation README and validation-receipt selected and fully readable alongside existing two archives/two closeout files. Preserve old FAIL/partial, AGENTS truncation/method0-of10 and document-first-failure history.

criteria.title: Zero writes and private content
criteria.rule: Checker performs no writes, no pyc under -B, no private fulltext saved to shared project or audit evidence. Fixtures contain synthetic text only, no init/clone, app/service/business execution, network or real DB/credential reads.

criteria.title: Independent evidence and limits
criteria.rule: Author tests and QA independent adversarial cases separately recorded, findings kept with author repair/retest. File hashes/current version bound; mechanism tests do not count as new blind business success or platform/global automatic loading.

adversarial_minimum: long single-line UTF8 > several pages, CRLF and no terminal newline exact reassembly
all ten synthetic methods page coverage
bad/missing/malformed locator, symlink locator and symlink ancestor
wrong origin/revision, dirty/missing/blob-mode mismatch, denied read
invalid page/source/range/hash, version drift between page requests
